children: RNS Number : 2592V  HarbourVest Global Priv. Equity Ltd  17 September 2026

In compliance with UK Listing Rule 6.4.9 R, HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited ("HVPE" or the "Company") announces that Mr Steven Wilderspin, a non-executive Director of the Company, has been appointed as a director of Foresight Environmental Infrastructure Limited with effect from 17 September 2026.
About HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited:

HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited ("HVPE" or the "Company") is a Guernsey-incorporated, closed-end investment company which is listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 index. HVPE is designed to offer shareholders long-term capital appreciation by investing in a private equity portfolio diversified by geography, stage of investment, vintage year, and industry. The Company invests in and alongside HarbourVest-managed funds which focus on primary fund commitments, secondary investments and direct co-investments in operating companies. HVPE's investment manager is HarbourVest Advisers L.P., an affiliate of HarbourVest Partners, LLC, an independent, global private markets asset manager with over 44 years of experience.

HarbourVest is an independent, global private markets firm with over 44 years of experience and $165 billion of assets under management as of March 31, 2026. Our interwoven platform provides clients access to global primary funds, secondary transactions, direct co-investments, real assets and infrastructure, and private credit. Our strengths extend across strategies, enabled by our team of more than 1,200 employees, including more than 230 investment professionals across Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. We partner strategically and plan our offerings innovatively to provide our clients with access, insight, and global opportunities.
